memory_objects.content: The project will adopt an evaluation method based on the MEM 0 paper, utilizing the LOCOMO dataset. This approach uses the conversations for memory storage and the associated questions for testing retrieval. The test questions cover single-hop, multi-hop, temporal reasoning, and open domain categories, but specifically exclude questions that are unanswerable or outside the provided knowledge scope.
